scenes.title: PSL SESAME Historical Optical Bench (2009)
scenes.institution: Universite Psl — Observatoire de Paris SESAME adaptive-optics bench, Meudon
scenes.reference_notes: Two actual photographs show a large perforated optical table on isolated legs, with many vertically mounted circular optics, linear mounts, cameras and trailing control cables. Desks and screens sit against the rear wall, while a black curtain borders the work area. Historical 2009 gallery, not a verified 2026 arrangement. SESAME documentation locates the bench in the basement of building 18 at Meudon, shared with another bench; do not count that other bench as another lab. No adaptive-optics wavefront or telescope-performance solver.

scenes.title: Polimi White Aeroacoustic Chamber
scenes.institution: Politecnico Di Milano — DAER Aeroacoustic Wind Tunnel, Galleria Bianca
scenes.reference_notes: The installed chamber interior has dense white acoustic wedges on walls and ceiling, a square framed flow opening with a dark interior, a narrow stand carrying a microphone-like probe and black absorptive panels around the measurement area. The official gallery includes several different tunnels; this record uses only the white aeroacoustic chamber view and does not merge the blue Sergio De Ponte hall. Hidden supports, floor layout and exact mount placements remain unknown. No acoustic propagation or aerodynamic solver.

scenes.title: Sheffield Diamond Pilot Process Bay
scenes.institution: University Of Sheffield — Diamond Integrated Pilot Plant process bay
scenes.reference_notes: Actual process-bay photographs show stainless equipment spread across raised grated platforms with wide stairs and handrails. A large GEA housing stands above piping and vessels; another angle shows a tall process vessel beside full-height glazing and a control cabinet. Official page lists several co-located process systems, but exact connections between the two photographed viewpoints are not established. Do not invent a complete process flow or claim tableting, reaction, fermentation, sterility or product quality. Use inert rigid samples and mechanical access controls only.
